items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Roy Palmer? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't remember Roy Palmer.

ctx.x: used to call them melodians, they was a red big thing and they had like pipes, you know, come up, and they had small one and then they'd go right on straight on up, some as long as what he is there. See they had like hole cut in them like, like them flutes, them flutes that you used to call them melodians. In the later years they started calling them organ, pipe organs. Well then they'd have a fella back there, he'd be there pumping the thing while the organist would be playing, you see, but he'd be back there,…
I'm wondering about some more of the trombonists when you were young. Did you ever hear Roy Palmer? Do you remember Roy Palmer?
No, I don't remember Roy Palmer.
